notes: Machine-readable dependency inventory. Enforced by scripts/license-audit.sh; mirrored for humans in LICENSES.md. Rationale and per-platform acquisition: docs/spikes/fe0-deps.md.

dependencies.name: Qt
dependencies.note: Widgets/Gui/OpenGL(+OpenGLWidgets for QOpenGLWidget, spec §6.1) only. No QML; no copyleft-only modules (Quick3D, Wayland Compositor).

dependencies.name: libvlc
dependencies.note: Raw C API headers; no libvlcpp wrapper (avoids compiling an LGPL header into the binary). Linux: distro libvlc-dev (apt), verified/installed by scripts/vendor-deps.sh; nothing vendored into the tree.

dependencies.name: projectM
dependencies.note: Latest release 4.1.8 cannot host in QOpenGLWidget: projectm_opengl_render_frame() hardcodes draw framebuffer 0, but QOpenGLWidget renders into its own FBO. projectm_opengl_render_frame_fbo() (API 4.2.0, unreleased) renders the widget. Pinned to master until 4.2.0 ships. Spiked in FE-14 (docs/spikes/projectm-qt.md).

dependencies.name: SQLite
dependencies.note: Public domain — static is permitted. FTS5 enabled.

dependencies.name: libcurl
dependencies.note: Range-capable HTTP for server streams and discovery. FE-5 verified pin: 8.18.0 (Ubuntu 24.04 libcurl4-openssl-dev, CURL::libcurl); project floor 8.x.

dependencies.name: JSON
dependencies.note: nlohmann/json; the one DOM FE-5/FE-14 use. Chosen over simdjson in FE-5 (docs/spikes/koalapaw-port.md).

dependencies.name: Catch2
dependencies.note: Test framework, fetched at configure time via CMake FetchContent (URL+SHA256).

dependencies.name: zlib
dependencies.note: WSZ/WAL containers are ZIPs (FE-3/SE-1). Permissive license; pre-allowed in allowed_non_lgpl_licenses.
